description: This file defines the ViewMain class which extends SugarView. It handles the display logic for the main view in the ModuleBuilder module of SuiteCRM, including rendering different trees and UI components based on request parameters.

classes.name: ViewMain
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering the main interface of the ModuleBuilder module in SuiteCRM, including handling different layout modes and initializing necessary components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view with footer display options.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module's title, incorporating translation and module title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the main view, dynamically loading different trees based on the request parameter and integrating various UI components.
